evidence.note: MigrateLegacyRuns: lock under common dir, re-read under lock, no-overwrite collision handling, bookkeeping skipped; targeted tests pass
MigrateLegacyRows: lenient legacy decode, fsm-* only, collided rows deferred, conflicts not stamped; appendRow re-checks id under flock so a concurrent pass is idempotent
roots(): anchor + common dir resolved, runs migrated before rows with collisions passed through; Store/Sidecar/Terminal now wired to common dir
fromRunRunsDir reads the common store first, then only the single main-checkout legacy location with a warning; covered by session_test.go
Ran go test -run Migrate|Pending|Sidecar|ValidateFromRun|FromRun on internal/fsm/run, internal/fsm/record, internal/fsm/machine, cmd/metareview: all ok

findings.note: MigrateLegacyRuns moves each run with os.Rename; if the common dir sits on a different filesystem from the main checkout (e.g. git init --separate-git-dir onto another volume) the rename fails with EXDEV and, since roots() propagates the error, every fsm command fails with ERR_STORE_PATH until the legacy runs are moved by hand. Rare configuration; a copy-then-remove fallback or a clearer hint would harden it.
